rationale: Pose suggests intentional presentation rather than candid activity due to symmetry and muscle engagement

limitations: No textual or contextual cues confirm intentional symbolism; interpretation relies solely on formal composition.

symbolic_mapping: solitary figure against vast natural backdrop as metaphor for individual autonomy within impersonal systems
